sloka: तासु चैव प्रसुप्तासु सीता भर्तृहिते रता ।विलप्य करुणं दीना प्रशुशोच सुदुःखिता ।। ५.५८.८३ ।।।।
transliteration: tāsu caiva prasuptāsu sītā bhartṛhite ratā ।vilapya karuṇaṁ dīnā praśuśoca suduḥkhitā ।। 5.58.83 ।।।।

translations.english: When they had fallen asleep, the devoted Sita, miserable and grief-stricken, lamented pitifully.
